about: Every piece bundled with the app. Paths are relative to assets/library/. Each entry says where the music comes from and under what licence; test/release_content_test.dart enforces it. See CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Content and copyright'.

pieces.title: Lightly Row
pieces.source: German folk song. Notes-only encoding with chord symbols (scripts/clean_musicxml.py).

pieces.title: The Happy Farmer, Op.68 No.10
pieces.source: Schumann, Album für die Jugend, Op. 68 No. 10 (1848). Notes-only encoding (scripts/clean_musicxml.py).

pieces.title: Gavotte (Gossec)
pieces.source: Gossec, Gavotte from the opera Rosine (1786). Notes-only encoding (scripts/clean_musicxml.py).

pieces.title: The Wellerman
pieces.source: New Zealand whaling song, 19th century. Converted from docs/wellerman.abc by the app's ABC import.

pieces.title: Old Joe Clark
pieces.source: American fiddle tune. Converted from docs/wellerman.abc (tune X:2, which shares the file with The Wellerman) by the app's ABC import.
